core_parser_differences: The eval parser rejects duplicate JSON keys anywhere; the old reward's json.loads keeps the last.
The eval parser rejects NaN, Infinity and -Infinity anywhere; the old reward can accept them in ignored metadata.
Eval requires str. The old reward also accepts bytes or bytearray containing a valid JSON object.
Eval catches RecursionError for excessive JSON nesting. The old reward can propagate it.
protocol: Task 05 uses generated text only. The ORM reconstructs this from generated token IDs using the same fast DecodeStream and prompt suffix. The renderer-added think block is outside raw text. No whitespace stripping, EOS-string replacement or trailing-text repair is performed.
recall_reference: Map saved available-gold lids to corpus pids; intersect with recorded keep_after pids.
